content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Donna Ball (E024)
Request: write access to Source Code

Facts:
- Role: Payroll Specialist
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic

Policy:
- Contractors: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- Donna has basic training, so max is read.

Requested level: write. Maximum allowed: read (since basic training, not advanced). So grant max = read.

Also note: Payroll Specialist role owns Payroll system, not Source Code. Engineer owns Source Code. But that matters only for admin. Contractor never admin anyway.

So decision: read.
